  "contact_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,

);", "CREATE TABLE "policy" (
  "policy_number" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "insurance_type" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "premium" REAL NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "hire_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("agent_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "customer" (
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id_card_number" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("customer_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "policy" (
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "insurance_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "insured_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "insurance_term" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "premium" REAL NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "agent_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("policy_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customer" ("customer_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("agent_id") REFERENCES "agent" ("agent_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "payment" (
  "payment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "payment_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "payment_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("payment_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("policy_id") REFERENCES "policy" ("policy_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "medical_record" (
  "record_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "record_content" TEXT,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customer" ("customer_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "claim_record" (
  "claim_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "claim_content" TEXT,
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("claim_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("policy_id") REFERENCES "policy" ("policy_id")
);"]

  "hire_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("agent_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "customer" (

  "id_card_number" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("customer_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "policy" (
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "insurance_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "insured_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "insurance_term" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "premium" REAL NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "agent_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("policy_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customer" ("customer_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("agent_id") REFERENCES "agent" ("agent_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "payment" (
  "payment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "payment_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "payment_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("payment_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("policy_id") REFERENCES "policy" ("policy_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "medical_record" (
  "record_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "record_content" TEXT,
  "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("customer_id") REFERENCES "customer" ("customer_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "claim_record" (
  "claim_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "claim_content" TEXT,
  "policy_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("claim_id"),

);"]

  "class" TEXT,
  "enrollment_time" TEXT,
  "place_of_residence" TEXT,

  "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "course_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "course_description" TEXT,
  "course_status" TEXT,

);", "CREATE TABLE "teacher" (
  "teacher_number" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "gender" TEXT,
  "title" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("teacher_number")
);", "CREATE TABLE "selection" (
  "student_number" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "order_date" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "password" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "other_info" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "attractions" (
  "attraction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "description" TEXT,
  "location" TEXT,
  "image_url" TEXT,
  "category" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("attraction_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "honors" (
  "honor_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "attraction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,

  FOREIGN KEY ("attraction_id") REFERENCES "attractions" ("attraction_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "comments" (
  "comment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

);", "CREATE TABLE "carousel_images" (

  "image_url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "creation_time" TEXT NOT NULL,

);"]

  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "home_address" TEXT,
  "registration_eligibility" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "course_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "credits" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "instructor" TEXT,
  "class_time" TEXT,
  "location" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("course_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "examination_result" (
  "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "examination_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "grade" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "examination_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("result_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "registration" (

  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("course_id") REFERENCES "course" ("course_id")
);"]

["CREATE TABLE "housekeeper" (
  "staff_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_number" TEXT,
  "service_type" TEXT,
  "years_of_experience" INTEGER,
  "professional_skills" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("staff_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "service_team" (
  "team_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "team_name" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("team_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "team_member" (
  "team_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "staff_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("team_id", "staff_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("team_id") REFERENCES "service_team" ("team_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("staff_id") REFERENCES "housekeeper" ("staff_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "service_task" (
  "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "customer_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_address" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_duration" REAL NOT NULL,
  "staff_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("staff_id") REFERENCES "housekeeper" ("staff_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "service_record" (
  "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "service_fee" REAL NOT NULL,
  "service_effectiveness" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "customer_evaluation" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "service_task" ("task_id")
);"]

  "traffic_status" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "remarks" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "failure_occurrence_time"),

  "staff_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "contact_information" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("staff_id")

  "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "disconnection_time" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "staff_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "staff_id", "maintenance_time"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("device_id") REFERENCES "device" ("device_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("staff_id") REFERENCES "staff" ("staff_id")
);"]

["CREATE TABLE "student" (
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "class" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "major" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("student_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "task" (
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "task_title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "task_description" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "task_start_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "task_end_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "task_location" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "simulation_module" (
  "module_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "module_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "module_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "module_description" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "module_code" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("module_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "simulation_result" (
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "module_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "simulation_result_data" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "result_analysis" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "simulation_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("student_id", "module_id", "simulation_date"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("module_id") REFERENCES "simulation_module" ("module_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "thesis" (
  "thesis_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "thesis_title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "thesis_content" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "submission_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("thesis_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id")
);"]

  "id_card_back_photo" TEXT,
  "facial_recognition_status" INTEGER,
  "avatar" TEXT,
  "nickname" TEXT,
  "gender" TEXT,
  "age" INTEGER,
  "location" TEXT,
  "personal_introduction" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "products" (
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "seller_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "detailed_description" TEXT,
  "condition_description" TEXT,
  "original_price" REAL,
  "selling_price" REAL NOT NULL,
  "category" TEXT,
  "transaction_location" TEXT,
  "price_negotiation_range" TEXT,
  "validity_period" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"),

);", "CREATE TABLE "product_photos" (
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "photo_index" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "photo_url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "photo_index"),

);", "CREATE TABLE "transactions" (
  "transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "buyer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "transaction_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "transaction_location" TEXT,
  "transaction_method" TEXT,
  "evaluation" TEXT,
